authorization.instruction: continue the pipeline. i defer to your judgement on what should be accepted. assume i accept whatever it is that you recommend and keep going

evidence_basis.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L4.0 rigid-strut rail oracle, L4.1 hinged-strut static load curve, and L4.3 two-link vertical-carriage support program scopes named by the source-pinned programs. The Generic6DOF vertical rail is an explicit material scaffold whose vertical axis is unlocked and whose observed reaction is retained; ordinary distal floor contact, paired finite joint torque, aggregate external-load reconstruction, crouch/rise work, the declared downward impulse, and exact infeasibility controls retain their fixture, geometry, mass, timestep, solver, controller, and actuator scopes. It establishes rail-constrained articulated vertical support only, not general per-foot allocation, free-root standing or balance, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

accepted_capabilities: The declared L4.0 rigid strut free-falls at gravity without a floor and reconstructs 29.4 N support through ordinary distal floor contact on an explicit motorless and springless vertical rail

The declared L4.1 one-hinge rail strut matches the analytic static holding-torque curve at 0, 15, 30, and 45 degrees under reconstructed 29.4 N support while the matched 30-degree zero-torque control fails to hold

The declared L4.3 two-link rail leg carries aggregate weight, performs the bounded crouch and rise, retains joint-work and potential-energy accounting, and recovers from the declared downward carriage impulse
The declared L4.3 controller exposes its material rail reaction and refuses the exact unreachable-height and insufficient-actuator controls
supplementary_constraints: The Generic6DOF vertical rail is an explicit material scaffold that locks lateral translation and all root rotation while retaining vertical translation
The measured rail tangential load cannot be discarded, treated as negligible, or transferred to a free-root support claim
The support result uses ordinary distal contact with no foot pin, built-in joint motor, passive tissue, or controller root-rescue force
Only aggregate external load is reconstructed; no per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe allocation is available
L1.8 still forbids summing same-body multi-shape predicted impulses into a foot-load measurement
Every result remains bounded to the certified geometry, masses, height and load schedule, impulse, timestep, solver, controller, actuator ceiling, engine, and source
claim_boundary: BR6A accepts only the exact L4.0, L4.1, and L4.3 program claim scopes in certification br6a_20260723T121533Z_c0e72549 at source commit c0e725496c5daf6b55bab38b1485920e1d993ff8. The certification report's verbatim claim boundary, all three program scopes, and the material rail reaction remain controlling.
excluded_capabilities: The omitted L4.2 free-space tracking cell
A general contact wrench or continuous foot-force sensor
Per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe load allocation
A negligible, absent, or transferable rail reaction
Free-root standing, balance, or rail-independent support
Terrain robustness, morphology generality, complex-foot superiority, or endurance
Accepted encyclopedia knowledge or automatic creature guidance
downstream_open: Admit selected BR6A observations only through a separate append-only operation
Build and certify the next support-control rung while preserving the rail as an explicit material scaffold
Restore and control lateral root translation and root rotation before any free-root standing claim
Establish a validated multi-contact load-allocation method before any per-foot or per-toe claim
Establish contact-phase and support-force control before standing or bracing
Authorize creature guidance only from separately admitted knowledge and later accepted support milestones
Prove every future standing, bracing, fall-arrest, recovery, gait, and walking milestone separately
